_doc.purpose: Curated calendar of scheduled Elon-Musk tweet-rate catalysts. Each event multiplies the model's expected tweet rate while its [start, end] window is active. The predictor hot-reloads this file (within ~30s) so edits apply to a running bot without a restart.
_doc.curation_principle: Scheduled, verifiable catalysts ONLY -- earnings calls, rocket launches, keynotes -- from authoritative sources (corporate IR calendars, official launch manifests). Do NOT auto-populate this from social media or news feeds: that is an adversarial-poisoning surface (e.g. a fake 'Elon died' post). Reactive response to UNSCHEDULED bursts is already handled by dynamic phi reading our own tweet feed.

schema.name: human-readable label
schema.rate_multiplier: tweets/hour multiplier while the window is active (clamped 0.1-10.0 on load)
schema.source: where the date came from -- for audit
schema.estimated: true if the date is inferred from a pattern, not officially confirmed
